title: Claude helped me build the cozy theme park game of my dreams!
author: ExistentialEnso
selftext:
I'm a huge theme park enthusiast and wanted a game that was more relaxing to explore my hobby, so I built a game with tons of options for rides, shops, customization, etc. I put a ton of effort into refining everything, but there are so many little animations that would've taken me months, if not years, to do.

Opus 5.5 did most of the heavy lifting, though I experimented with using some open models on Ollama Cloud to do adversarial reviews and catch bugs easily. Performance was a bit mediocre at first too despite the simplicity of the graphics, but by pushing Opus 5.5 to keep doing deep dives looking for performance gains, it wound up running WAY faster.

comments.author: FrankenChocula
comments.body: I like these kinds of games.  Where do we play it, and what does it offer over something like Parkitect?
